caption: The drawing depicts two main objects set against a plain, beige background. The object on the left is a vessel with a bulbous, transparent green glass body, topped and bottomed with metallic-looking bands that appear to be weathered bronze or brass. The top section is dome-shaped and features a band with a pattern of small diamond-shaped perforations, and is crowned by a large, round metal loop handle secured to the dome with a bracket. To the right of this vessel is a separate circular metallic component, matching the style and color of the bands on the vessel, with a short wick at its center, charred at the tip. The metallic section on the right seems to function as a detachable base or burner, and it also has small perforations along its sides. The overall composition positions the glass vessel upright and the metallic base or burner lying flat, both centrally aligned on the page.
title: Lantern
